limits.applies:
!(has(company.facts.responsibility_system)
&&company.facts.responsibility_system == true
&&has(terms.facts)
&&has(terms.facts.responsibility_system_agreement)
&&terms.facts.responsibility_system_agreement != "")
&& (day.day_type != "REST"
|| (day.holiday_kind
in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"]
|| (day.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY"
&& (has(employee.facts.voting_right)
  ?employee.facts.voting_right == true
  : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth)
  &&employee.date_of_birth != null
  &&employee.date_of_birth != ""
  &&age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date) >= 20)))))
